assets.name: capybara-heart-hands
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: transparent hand-drawn mascot cutout
Primary request: a cute warm tan capybara standing with BOTH front paws together at chest height, fingers and thumbs making a clear heart-shaped opening, happy closed smiling eyes and tiny pink cheeks. Use reference only for exact drawing style: loose dark brown pencil outlines and warm muted crayon fills, simple round heavy proportions, adorable expressive face. Entire character including feet, ears, hands and gesture visible.
Style: flat 2D hand-drawn doodle, wobbly imperfect dark pencil outline, subtle warm textured crayon fill, minimal shading. Match existing capybara reference closely.
Composition: single full character centered, smaller within canvas so there is at least 15% fully transparent empty margin on EVERY side.
Scene: genuinely transparent alpha background.
Avoid: background, floor, ground, shadow, text, letters, symbols, floating hearts outside hands, props, sticker border, 3D, glossy render, cropped extremities.
